div.div:
black solid = direct compass travel
blue solid = vertical UP/DOWN (not compass N/S)
orange dashed = conditional · blue dotted = random %
grey dashed = message · purple dashed = special movement
dashed to gutter = leaves this page (marker shows exact destination)

div.div:
LOC_AWKWARD — Awkward canyon.
You are in an awkward sloping east/west canyon.
EXITS (source order)
DEPRE → LOC_GRATE · 01 — Surface World [not GRATE=GRATE_CLOSED]
ENTRA → LOC_BELOWGRATE
d → LOC_DEBRIS
INWAR → LOC_BIRDCHAMBER
PIT → LOC_PITTOP

div.div:
LOC_BELOWGRATE — below the grate
You are in a small chamber beneath a 3x3 steel grate to the surface.
A low crawl over cobbles leads inward to the west.
EXITS (source order)
OUT → LOC_GRATE · 01 — Surface World [not GRATE=GRATE_CLOSED]
OUT → say GRATE_NOWAY
crawl → LOC_COBBLE
PIT → LOC_PITTOP
DEBRI → LOC_DEBRIS

div.div:
LOC_BIRDCHAMBER — in bird chamber
You are in a splendid chamber thirty feet high. The walls are frozen
rivers of orange stone. An awkward canyon and a good passage exit
from east and west sides of the chamber.
EXITS (source order)
DEPRE → LOC_GRATE · 01 — Surface World [not GRATE=GRATE_CLOSED]
ENTRA → LOC_BELOWGRATE
DEBRI → LOC_DEBRIS
CANYO → LOC_AWKWARD
PASSA → LOC_PITTOP

div.div:
LOC_COBBLE — in cobble crawl
You are crawling over cobbles in a low passage. There is a dim light
at the east end of the passage.
EXITS (source order)
OUT → LOC_BELOWGRATE
INWAR → LOC_DEBRIS
PIT → LOC_PITTOP

div.div:
LOC_CRACK — The crack is far too small for you to follow. At...
The crack is far too small for you to follow. At its widest it is
barely wide enough to admit your foot.
EXITS (source order)
(implicit) → LOC_PITTOP

You are in a debris room filled with stuff washed in from the surface.
A low wide passage with cobbles becomes plugged with mud and debris
here, but an awkward canyon leads upward and west. In the mud someone

div.div:
LOC_EASTBANK — on east bank of fissure
You are on the east bank of a fissure slicing clear across the hall.
The mist is quite thick here, and the fissure is too wide to jump.
EXITS (source order)
HALL → LOC_MISTHALL
JUMP → say CROSS_BRIDGE [not FISSURE=UNBRIDGED]
FORWA → LOC_NOMAKE · 11 — Special & Transient States [not FISSURE=BRIDGED]
OVER → say NO_CROSS [not FISSURE=BRIDGED]
OVER → LOC_WESTBANK

You are at one end of a vast hall stretching forward out of sight to
the west. There are openings to either side. Nearby, a wide stone
staircase leads downward. The hall is filled with wisps of white mist
sw

LOC_NUGGET — in nugget-of-gold room
This is a low room with a crude note on the wall. The note says,
"You won't get it up the steps".
EXITS (source order)
HALL → LOC_MISTHALL

div.div:
LOC_PITTOP — at top of small pit
At your feet is a small pit breathing traces of white mist. An east
passage ends here except for a small crack leading on.
EXITS (source order)
DEPRE → LOC_GRATE · 01 — Surface World [not GRATE=GRATE_CLOSED]
ENTRA → LOC_BELOWGRATE
DEBRI → LOC_DEBRIS
PASSA → LOC_BIRDCHAMBER
d → LOC_NECKBROKE · 11 — Special & Transient States [carry NUGGET]
d → LOC_MISTHALL
CRACK → LOC_CRACK

LOC_WESTBANK — on west bank of fissure
You are on the west side of the fissure in the Hall of Mists.
EXITS (source order)
JUMP → say CROSS_BRIDGE [not FISSURE=UNBRIDGED]
FORWA → LOC_NOMAKE · 11 — Special & Transient States [not FISSURE=BRIDGED]

OVER → LOC_EASTBANK
north → LOC_PARALLEL1 · 04 — Maze (All Alike)
west → LOC_MISTWEST · 04 — Maze (All Alike)

div.div: Source: Open_Adventure.yaml (BSD-2-Clause, E. S. Raymond / Open Adventure) — canonical. Pilot: 12 locations, 51 travel rules preserved in source order. Editorial hint: WESTBANK placed west of EASTBANK per fissure descriptions. Generated by Mata Hari (Mission 003). North = up = smaller Y.
